title: Text content
description: The `text` content block, the baseline result type that every tool result may carry.
question: Does text content reach the agent unchanged?
notes: Text content arrives intact in both adapters that reach 2026-07-28; 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: Text survives unchanged in both adapters that reach 2026-07-28.
verdict.detail: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 keeps it as a text output item and Pydantic AI 2.40.0 returns it as a plain string. The text itself is byte-identical to the source in both. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: This is the one content type every framework is expected to handle, so it is the control row: the other content types can only be read as losses against a text block that survives.
